text:
anya: Quick note from some onboarding sessions: devs get a 502 during streaming and the client just throws "Connection closed". No request id or stream position, so they retry blindly.

sam.k: Oof. Streaming errors are trickier. We should include a `stream_offset` and `stream_id` in the envelope when applicable so clients can resume or fail fast.

leo: Also need to be careful about exposing too much internal routing info to hosted customers. For Dedicated/Private we can include instance tags, but for hosted we should surface a support token that maps internally.

maria: Back-compat asks: keep err.message and err.code string, but add err.meta (flat map) with stable keys. That way old clients that only check message still work.

sam.k: Suggested keys: code (string), http_status (string), retryable ("true"/"false"), retry_after (ms as string), request_id, stream_id, stream_offset, hint, support_token. Keep raw_text for the original payload.

leo: For generator-based SDKs (streaming) we should throw a specific StreamInterruptedError with meta so `for await` loops can decide whether to resume or abort.

anya: Onboarding sample tweak: show a distinct UI state for stream recoverable errors with a small "Resume" button. Docs should show how to use stream_id + offset to resume.

maria: Tests needed: simulate mid-stream 502 with meta.stream_id and assert sample app shows resume UI; unit test that errors from non-stream endpoints don't include stream keys.

sam.k: Devex action: define canonical codes for streaming: 'stream_interrupt', 'stream_timeout', 'stream_backpressure'. Add mapping rules for 5xx vs 4xx in the doc.

devex-bot: Created issue <https://git.internal/redwood/devex/issues/3720|devex#3720> - "SDK: streaming error envelope + resume semantics" assigned to leo.

leo: I'll prototype the JS Error subclass, add StreamInterruptedError, and a tiny sample demonstrating resume. Will include migration note about support_token vs request_id. ETA 1 week.

anya: Thanks — this should reduce noisy support pings from streaming examples.
